activity_statements.statement: operates movie theaters across the United States and internationally, offering ticketed film screenings in standard and premium formats (IMAX, Dolby Cinema, Prime at AMC)
sells concessions (food and beverages) in theaters, which represent a major component of per-patron revenue alongside ticket sales
operates AMC Stubs loyalty and subscription program enabling discounted or unlimited movie tickets for enrolled members
sells in-theater advertising time and screen space to national and local brand advertisers
sells and distributes gift cards and ticket vouchers for use at AMC locations

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Entertainment Providers' is accurate but could imply content creation; AMC does not produce films — it exhibits films made by studios, earning revenue primarily from ticket sales, concessions, and advertising rather than IP or content creation.
extraction_notes: amctheatres.com returned HTTP 500 error and queue/rate-limiting page. Very limited direct source content retrieved. Profile built primarily from what is publicly verifiable about AMC as a major movie theater chain. Confidence is reduced accordingly.
